name: asc-rs
title_zh: 按需拆开一个 APK 的局部，不整包反编译
tagline_zh: 只想确认某个类里到底写了什么、清单里声明了哪些权限，却不想等全量反编译跑完还堆出几万个文件？它按需列条目、读区间。
tagline_en: Need to check one class or a manifest flag without waiting on a full decompile that dumps thousands of files? It.
desc_en: Analyze user-provided Android APK files with ASC-RS by listing classes or archive entries, reading bounded entry ranges, decompiling a known class, locating bytecode references, or decoding AndroidManifest.xml. Use for focused local APK inspection; do not use for whole-app bulk decompilation or extraction, APK modification, signing, or installation.
why_zh: 把 APK 当可寻址的档案而不是待解压的压缩包：先列目录，再按名字精确取用，读多少由你定。
why_en: Treats the APK as an addressable archive, not a tarball to explode: list first, fetch by exact name, and you decide how much.
limit_zh: 只做定点查看：整包批量反编译、资源提取、改包、重签名、安装都不在范围内；要读的类得先知道名字或先列出来，模糊搜索帮不上。
limit_en: Point inspection only: no bulk decompile, resource extraction, repackaging, re-signing, or install. You must know or first list the class name.
title_en: Open just one corner of an APK, not the whole thing
